title: Law to require safety checks and shut-off switch for AI models
summary: This bill would make it illegal to market, sell or use an artificial intelligence model in New York City unless it has been checked by an independent third-party validator and has a technical ability for a human to shut it down. Validators would need to assess things like accuracy, bias, data privacy and safety, and report their findings to the city's Cyber Command office. Violations could bring civil penalties of up to $25,000 per instance, and the law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
